_source.note: Role-specific Lifepaths. 59 tables across 10 Roles. Mixed dice (1d10/1d6) and several choice-only tables. Entry counts verified against each table's stated die.

_rules.note: Same roll-or-choose model, same persistence shape, and same free-text override as the general Lifepath. Appends to the existing biography panel under a Role heading; does not start a new panel.
_rules.conditionalTables: Tables with a `dependsOn` are hidden until the gate table is answered with a revealing value. A Nomad picks Land, Air, or Sea and only that branch's table appears.

_schema.note: Every table object has an identical key set, and every entry is {roll, value}. Nullable fields are present as null rather than omitted, and no array is ever empty — this keeps TypeScript's inferred type from resolveJsonModule a single shape instead of a union, and avoids never[].

table.label: string
table.diePrinted: string | null — set only where it differs from die
table.entries: Array<{ roll: number | null, value: string }>

_schema.choiceOnlyNote: Choice-only tables express their options as entries with roll: null. Do not look for an `options` key.
